description: This file contains automated tests for account recovery functionalities, including recovery code retrieval, sign-in with recovery codes, MFA disablement post recovery sign-in, and validation for invalid credentials or recovery codes, implemented using Mocha and Chai.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup hook that initializes the application context before each test, including clearing local storage, creating a fake crypto context, launching the application, and registering the user.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Teardown hook that deinitializes the application context after each test and clears local storage.

methods.name: it('should get the same recovery code at each consecutive call')
methods.description: Test verifying that multiple calls to retrieve recovery codes return the same set of codes.

methods.name: it('should allow to sign in with recovery code')
methods.description: Test verifying that a user can sign in using recovery codes and that the root key is properly obtained.

methods.name: it('should automatically generate new recovery code after recovery sign in')
methods.description: Test verifying that after signing in with recovery codes, new codes are generated, replacing previous ones.

methods.name: it('should disable MFA after recovery sign in')
methods.description: Test ensuring that multi-factor authentication is disabled after signing in with recovery codes.

methods.name: it('should not allow to sign in with recovery code and invalid credentials')
methods.description: Test to confirm that sign-in with recovery codes fails when credentials are invalid.

methods.name: it('should not allow to sign in with invalid recovery code')
methods.description: Test to ensure that invalid recovery codes prevent sign-in attempts.

methods.name: it('should not allow to sign in with recovery code if user has none')
methods.description: Test to confirm that sign-in fails when user has no recovery codes set.
